fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (site listing page) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S1b-custom-page, S2-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, unexpected_shape).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from paragraph tags (article mode). For a small minority of long-read/listicle articles built with a different page template, reconstructed from that template's text blocks instead -- see _source.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name (article mode) -- observed as Cyrillic (Russian or Uzbek Cyrillic script) even on the English edition; kept as raw passthrough.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization name (article mode only), as emitted by the site's own JSON-LD.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline as shown on the latest-news listing page (latest mode).

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp (site-local, UTC+5), parsed from the "HH:MM / DD.MM.YYYY" timestamp shown next to each headline on the listing page (latest mode).

publishedDate.title: Published date
publishedDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) parsed from the article's own URL path (latest mode), as a fallback in case the timestamp span is ever missing.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
